info.text:
Your bank's fraud department will never ask you this.

"Move your money to a safe account" is the scam. The FCC: "Banks will never call or text and ask you to move your money to protect it."
In 2025, people reported losing nearly $1 billion to business impersonators, with bank impersonators causing the highest losses.
Imposter scams overall: $3.5 billion in 2025, up from $1.2 billion in 2020.
Caller ID showing your bank's name can be spoofed.

Sources: FTC Consumer Sentinel data (June 2026), FTC consumer alerts, FCC bank impersonation alert (July 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
